sentence: This project provides shared molecular methods to profile neurons and shows how this can help find drugs that raise the ventilatory response to hypercarbia.
This project studies how the bacterium Pseudomonas aeruginosa survives two classes of antibiotic and how interactions with another species change its response to the drugs.
This project studies whether three recent telehealth initiatives for mental health care help prevent suicide among Veterans and how they affect health disparities.
This project offers proteomics services that measure proteins in cancer studies and builds software tools to help interpret the data.
This project runs a secure virtual data enclave that gives approved researchers remote access to restricted data from studies on aging.
This project studies how obesity-related hyperinsulinemia and inflammation harm mammary gland development and lactation in mothers with obesity.
This project tests whether drugs that strongly lower cholesterol could help prevent or treat abdominal aortic aneurysm, using human genetic evidence and a clinical trial.
This project studies how amino acids in tumor cells and tumor stiffness affect the ability of T cells to kill tumors.
This project studies how phosphate travels from the circulation to the enamel space and the roles of channels that move it across cells.
This project studies how a chemical ligand that binds an oncogenic transcription factor works in melanoma cells and whether it can be improved.
This project studies where a microbial metabolite called trimethylamine N-oxide comes from and how it affects anti-tumor immunity in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.
This project studies which genomic and transcriptomic features shape chemo-immunomodulation in metastatic triple-negative breast cancer and builds a machine-learning-based model to predict it.
This project uses data from completed clinical trials and registries to sort people with Alzheimer's disease into clinically targetable groups.
This project searches for genes in artery smooth muscle cells that cause unstable atherosclerotic plaque and raise cardiovascular disease risk, apart from blood cholesterol.
This project studies how two forms of a single protein control the development of the immune system.
This project offers flow and mass cytometry services that sort and analyze immune cells to support cancer therapy studies.
This project uses artificial intelligence to study digital pathology images of Ewing sarcoma and find patterns that may predict which patients have poor outcomes.
This project brings together patient data and laboratory research to find the causes of temporomandibular disorders and develop personalized treatments.
This project builds machine learning tools that read tissue images and blood data from aging mice to predict aging.
This project studies how methionine metabolism and specific tumor genetic and epigenetic pathways drive nasopharyngeal and gastric carcinomas.
